# Bug Report Template

**Title:** [Area] <What is wrong> when <condition>
_e.g. [Cart] Standard shipping charged when subtotal is exactly 1,000 THB_

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| ID / Link | |
| Environment | app version/commit · environment URL · browser + version · OS · bug mode/config |
| Requirement | REQ-… |
| Severity | Critical / Major / Minor / Trivial |
| Priority | P1 / P2 / P3 / P4 (agreed with PO) |
| Reproducibility | Always / Intermittent (x of y) |

**Preconditions**
- user/role, data state

**Steps to reproduce**
1.
2.
3.

**Expected result** (quote the requirement)

**Actual result** (exact message / numbers / status code)

**Evidence**
- Screenshot / video
- Playwright `trace.zip` or Robot `log.html`
- API request/response (Copy as cURL), HAR
- Server log excerpt with timestamp

**Notes / analysis** (boundaries tried, workaround, suspected cause — optional)

---
Checklist before submitting: ☐ reproduced twice ☐ searched for duplicates ☐ one bug per report ☐ neutral wording ☐ evidence attached
